verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents an official CLI for managing tenant configuration, automating tasks and integrating Auth0 into deployment workflows. It also documents the Client Credentials flow for non-interactive M2M clients such as CLIs, daemons and backend services, which together support headless automation. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline docs or examples (e.g. non-interactive CLI auth in CI runners), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
